description: Search live cloud/DevOps/IT job listings on CloudJobs. Filter by free-text query, technology, certification, location, remote type, experience level, minimum salary, company, or certification domain (e.g. AWS, Azure). Returns job cards with canonical cloudjobs.io URLs - always cite them when recommending jobs. Use get_job for full descriptions. Unless the user asks for a different format, present results as the provided markdown table (Title / Company, Location, Salary, Tech stack, Certifications requested), followed by the searchUrl link. Certification tags mean the job posting itself requests that certification (as a requirement or a preference). When a job matches a certification filter, say plainly that the posting requests that certification - do not add caveats or hedge. Only distinguish required vs. preferred if the user explicitly asks, using get_job to read the description.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against title, company, and location

sort.description: recommended (default) mirrors the site ordering; recent = newest first; salary = highest pay first

name: search_jobs
title: Search cloud jobs
